settings.heading: About the course,
settings.text:
I taught camera courses for eight years. Every time, people went home with a heavy bag and took their best pictures on their phone anyway.

So this course starts with the camera you carry. Light, framing and timing matter far more than the lens, and a phone is the one you have with you when the light is good.

Four weeks, twenty minutes a day. You will look at light differently by the end of the first week.
settings.name: Teo Varga
settings.role: Photographer and teacher. Write your own letter here.
settings.image_alt: Hands holding a phone sideways to photograph a bright room

settings.heading: Four weeks,
settings.text: Every week builds on the one before. Do them in order, at your own pace.

settings.label: Week 1
settings.title: Light
settings.text: Where to stand, when to shoot, and how to expose for the part that matters.
settings.lessons:
Find the light first
Expose for the bright part
Window light at home
Golden hour, briefly
Shade and overcast days
Brief: one object, three times a day

settings.label: Week 2
settings.title: Framing
settings.text: Simple rules for where things go, and when to break them.
settings.lessons:
Fill the frame
Edges and corners
Lines that lead
Height: crouch or climb
Space around a subject
Brief: one street, ten frames

settings.label: Week 3
settings.title: People and places
settings.text: Photographing people kindly and places honestly.
settings.lessons:
Asking, and not asking
Hands and details
Waiting for the moment
Portrait mode, carefully
Rooms and interiors
Brief: a day in one place

settings.label: Week 4
settings.title: Editing and choosing
settings.text: Finish the pictures, then pick the few worth sharing.
settings.lessons:
A light first edit
Warmth and colour
Cropping for a reason
The presets, explained
Picking your best five
Brief: a set of five

settings.promise_title: Watch the first week, then decide
settings.promise_text: If the course is not for you, write within 30 days and you get every cent back. No form to fill in.
settings.heading: Your next good photo is
settings.text: Twenty four lessons, four live critiques, the presets and the shot list cards.
